Factset Upload a Custom Document

request.name: Factset Upload a Custom Document

description.content: Upload any thrid-party documents that need to be included in the final PDF. Once uploaded, the successful response will be a unique fileurl that can be used to add the files to the PDF output using the create-book endpoint. Supported files include Powerpoint, Word, RTF and PDF. The total size should not exceed 250MB and each file should not exceed 10MB.

response.name: Successful response contains file name, fileURL of the book uploaded
